canonical_source.visible_control: Clone as new / نسخ كخطة جديدة [CloneCurrent]

source_semantics.precondition: CloneCurrent is available only for the currently edited plan.
source_semantics.state_source: The operation copies the current editor form values, including unsaved field edits; immutable plan code comes from the currently edited plan state.

transformations.editing_id: cleared so the next explicit save is a create rather than an update

source_semantics.message_en: A disabled clone is ready. Adjust its code and details, then save it.
source_semantics.message_ar: تم تجهيز نسخة غير مفعلة. غيّر الكود والبيانات ثم احفظها.
source_semantics.persistence: none until the separately governed SaveAsync operation is explicitly invoked
source_semantics.provider_behavior: none; CloneCurrent clears provider identifiers locally and does not call PayPal

laravel_adaptation.code_source: immutable data-plan-code from the same persisted plan article
laravel_adaptation.create_target: the real data-plan-create-form already used by the separately governed save operation

runtime_path: authenticated settings manager opens the tenant-scoped Subscription Plans page
each persisted plan editor renders a Clone as new button carrying the canonical operation marker
button click reads the live current editor values directly in the browser, so unsaved edits are preserved
the create form receives code-name transformations plus the remaining current editor values
the create form enabled checkbox is forced off and both PayPal identifier inputs are cleared
the localized clone-ready message is surfaced and focus moves to the new code field
no request, form submit, database write, audit write, queue job, or provider call occurs

authorization_and_isolation.plan_source: only plan editors rendered from the active server-authorized tenant page can originate the browser operation
authorization_and_isolation.caller_query_override: not used; CloneCurrent does not consume a clone plan id or plan fields from query/body input
authorization_and_isolation.idor_surface: none introduced by this local visible-control operation

security_and_truthfulness.network_primitives: the dedicated clone script contains no fetch, XMLHttpRequest, form submit, or requestSubmit call

terminality.basis: The exact CloneCurrent behavior is now a real local visible control over the current editor state: it preserves unsaved plan edits, applies the source code/name transforms, prepares a disabled provider-free create form, reports the localized ready message, performs no network or persistence action, preserves tenant authorization, and has focused deterministic coverage.
